steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Make PBS-BSA (0.01% BSA using 10% stock) fresh before each experiment.
Prepare 50 mL of TE-SDS: 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, and 0.5% SDS.

steps.title: Prepare Barcoded Beads from Dry Resin
steps.instruction: Process the dry barcoded beads (Chemgenes Catalog #Macosko-2011-10) for use.

substeps.instruction: Wash the resin with 30 mL ethanol.
Wash twice with 30 mL TE-TW.
Resuspend in 20 mL TE-TW.
Pass the beads through a 100 micron strainer.
Count beads using a Fuchs-Rosenthal hemocytometer.
Store counted beads at 4 °C.
Note: To pellet beads during washing, centrifuge at 1000xg for 1 minute. Do NOT vortex; mix by gentle inversion.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate and dilute nuclei for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Prepare nuclei following the 'Isolation of single nuclei from solid tissues' protocol steps 1-14 (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufketkw).
Dilute nuclei to 100 cells/ul using PBS-BSA for the final dilution.

steps.title: Set Up Pump System and Hardware
steps.instruction: Configure the syringe pumps and microfluidic device.

substeps.instruction: Power on three Legato 100 syringe pumps and set flow rates: Oil (15,000 ul/hr), Cells (4,000 ul/hr), and Beads (4,000 ul/hr).
Prepare the PDMS co-flow microfluidic device: remove the protective plastic top layer and connect the outflow tubing to a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Arrange pumps next to the Motic AE31 inverted microscope.
Position the bead pump syringe pointing downward and place a VP Scientific magnetic stirrer close to the bead syringe barrel.

steps.title: Prepare Syringes and Lines
steps.instruction: Assemble the fluidic lines for 4-6 samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare syringes: 10 mL for oil, 3 mL for cells/samples, and 3 mL with magnetic mixing discs for beads.
Cut tubing with one blunt end (for needle) and one angled end (for device).
UV treat all tubing and needles.
Coat connecting tubing and syringes with 1% BSA to prevent non-specific binding, then rinse with PBS.

steps.title: Load Syringes
steps.instruction: Fill syringes while minimizing air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Load solutions by pressing a 1000 ul pipette tip into the syringe head and pulling the plunger back.
Keep syringes vertical to push out air bubbles; affix 26G needles and tubing.
Flush cell/sample lines with 1 mL cell buffer.
Flush bead lines with 1 mL DTT minus lysis buffer.
Load cells/nuclei and beads into their respective syringes, ensuring no bubbles.
Keep bead syringes horizontal after loading to prevent clogging.

steps.title: Assemble and Prime System
steps.instruction: Connect syringes to the microfluidic device and prime the lines.

substeps.instruction: Secure the oil syringe in the pump, prime until oil drips from the tube, and push the angled end into the device.
Secure the cell/sample syringe, prime until buffer drips, and push the angled end into the device.
Turn on the magnetic mixer (speed 25-30) and rotate the bead syringe by hand to mix beads in lysis buffer.
Secure the bead syringe in the pump, ensuring the magnetic disc circles vertically, prime until buffer drips, and push the angled end into the device.

steps.title: Generate and Collect Droplets
steps.instruction: Run the pumps to produce uniform droplets.

substeps.instruction: Start the oil pump, then the bead pump, then the cells/sample pump.
Direct outflow to waste and monitor beads moving into the device chamber.
Collect a drop on a microscope slide and verify uniform size and shape under a microscope.
Once uniform, collect droplets in 15 mL Falcon tubes until the cell/sample runs out (pump alarm will sound).
Stop all pumps and place the 15 mL collection tube on ice.
Repeat for additional samples if necessary.

steps.title: Clean Up Hardware
steps.instruction: Decommission the system after droplet collection.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic mixer and power off pumps.
Dispose of cell/sample tubing, syringes, and needles in biohazardous waste.
Dispose of other lines, syringes, and needles in regular waste.

steps.title: Recover Barcoded Beads (STAMPs)
steps.instruction: Isolate the beads from the droplets using a filter.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 30 um Uberstrainer over a 50 mL waste tube and moisten the filter with 1 mL cold 6X SSC.
Pass the aqueous and organic phases through the strainer.
Rinse the 15 mL collection tube with a few mL of cold 6X SSC and pass through the strainer.
Rinse the strainer twice with cold 6X SSC.
Reverse the strainer over a clean 50 mL Falcon tube and wash the strainer 5 times with 1 mL cold 6X SSC to recover all beads.

steps.title: Wash and Prepare Beads for RT
steps.instruction: Clean the recovered beads and transfer them to a microfuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL tube at 1000xg for 1 minute at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant, leaving ~1 mL cold 6X SSC.
Resuspend beads in the remaining 6X SSC and transfer to a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Spin down (1000xg for 1 minute).
Wash twice with 1 mL cold 6X SSC.
Wash with 300 µL 5X RT buffer and remove as much buffer as possible without losing beads.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Generate cDNA strands on the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL RT Mix (containing Maxima H-RTase) to the beads.
Incubate at room temperature with rotation for 30 minutes.
Incubate at 42 °C with rotation for 1.5 hours.
Wash beads once with 1 mL TE-SDS and twice with 1 mL TE-TW.
If proceeding to Exonuclease I, wash once with 1 mL 10 mM Tris pH 8.0.
Resuspend beads in 200 µL Exonuclease Mix.
Incubate at 37 °C with rotation for 45 minutes.
Wash beads once with 1 mL TE-SDS and twice with 1 mL TE-TW.
If proceeding to PCR, wash once with 1 mL H2O.

steps.title: Bead Counting and PCR Apportionment
steps.instruction: Determine bead concentration to distribute samples into PCR tubes.

substeps.instruction: After the H2O wash, spin down beads and remove supernatant.
Resuspend in 1 mL H2O and mix well by pipetting.
Pipette 20 µL into a Fuchs-Rosenthal hemocytometer and count all 16 boxes.
Calculate concentration: (beads counted / 16) x 5 beads/ul.
Apportion 2,000 beads into each PCR tube.

steps.title: cDNA Amplification (PCR)
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using a Master Mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Master Mix (50 µL per reaction): 24.6 µL H2O, 0.4 µL 100 uM SMART PCR Primer, and 25 µL 2x Kapa HiFi Hotstart ReadyMix.
Perform PCR and purify the product using 30 µL (0.6x ratio) KAPA PureBeads or AMPure XP beads.
Elute in 10 µL H2O.
Confirm average cDNA library size (1300-2000 bp) via gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Tagmentation and Library Work-up
steps.instruction: Tag and fragment the cDNA library.

substeps.instruction: Tagment the cDNA library using transposomes per Illumina Nextera instructions.
Prepare PCR Master Mix (24 µL per reaction): 15 µL Nextera PCR mix, 8 µL H2O, and 1 µL 10 uM New-P5-SMART PCR hybrid oligo.
Purify the resulting library using 30 µL (0.6x ratio) magnetic beads and elute in 12-15 µL H2O.
Confirm sequencing library size (target 500-680 bp, range 420-700 bp) via gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Final Purification and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup and sequence on MiSeq.

substeps.instruction: Perform a second 0.6x magnetic bead purification and elute in 12-15 µL H2O.
Pool 8-12 libraries to make a 10 µL pool at 3 nM for denaturation.
Dilute and load the combined library at 12 pM to the sequencer.
Sequencing specs: Read 1 (30 bp), Read 2 (75-100 bp), Read 1 Index (8 bp), using Custom Read 1 primer.
